question: Digital lending loan ke liye borrower ko cooling-off period me exit karne ka kya provision hai?
expected_answer: Borrower cooling-off period (RE ke Board dwara decide, minimum 1 din) ke andar loan exit kar sakta hai, sirf principal + us din tak ka proportionate APR pay karke, bina kisi penalty ke. RE ek reasonable one-time processing fee retain kar sakta hai, jo KFS me disclose karna zaroori hai.
system_answer:
Digital lending loan ke liye cooling-off period mein exit karne ka provision nimnlikhit hai:

*   **Exit ka vikalp:** Borrower ko digital loan se exit karne ka spasht (explicit) vikalp diya jayega. Iske liye borrower ko sirf principal aur anupatik (proportionate) APR ka bhugtan karna hoga, aur is par koi penalty nahi lagayi jayegi [RBI/2025-26/36::10(i)], [RBI/2022-23/111::8].
*   **Cooling-off period ki avdhi:** 
    *   Regulated Entity (RE) ka Board apni loan policy ke anusar cooling-off period nirdharit karega [RBI/2025-26/36::10(i)], [RBI/2022-23/111::8].
    *   Yeh avdhi kam se kam ek din ki honi chahiye [RBI/2025-26/36::10(i)].
    *   Kuch mamlon mein, 7 din ya usse adhik ke tenor wale loan ke liye yeh avdhi kam se kam teen din aur 7 din se kam ke tenor wale loan ke liye kam se kam ek din ki honi chahiye [RBI/2022-23/111::8].
*   **Processing fee:** Agar customer cooling-off period ke dauran loan se exit karta hai, toh RE ek uchit (reasonable) one-time processing fee rakh sakta hai, yadi yeh lagu ho. Iski jankari customer ko Key Fact Statement (KFS) mein pehle hi di jani chahiye [RBI/2025-26/36::10(ii)].
*   **KFS mein jankari:** Cooling-off/look-up period ka vivaran Key Fact Statement (KFS) mein shamil hona chahiye [RBI/2022-23/111::5.2.2].

question: DLG (Default Loss Guarantee) ka maximum cap kitna hai?
expected_answer: Kisi specified loan portfolio pe total DLG cover, total disbursed amount ke 5% se zyada nahi ho sakta, kisi bhi point in time pe.
system_answer:
JAWAB:

DLG (Default Loss Guarantee) cover ka maximum cap kisi bhi outstanding portfolio par us loan portfolio ki amount ka 5% hai [RBI/2023-24/41::6]. Implicit guarantee arrangements ke mamle mein bhi, DLG Provider performance risk ke roop mein underlying loan portfolio ki 5% ki raashi se adhik ka bojh nahi utha sakta [RBI/2023-24/41::6].

question: RE ko DLG kab tak invoke karna hota hai agar loan default ho jaye?
expected_answer: RE ko DLG maximum 120 days overdue ke andar invoke karna hota hai (ya usse pehle agar borrower payment kar de).
system_answer: JAWAB: RE ko DLG, loan overdue hone ke maximum 120 din ke bhitar invoke karna hota hai, jab tak ki borrower dwara usse pehle loan dues ka bhugtan na kar diya jaye [RBI/2025-26/36::26] [RBI/2023-24/41::9].

question: DLG provider kaun ban sakta hai?
expected_answer: DLG sirf LSP ke saath ya RE-jo-khud-LSP-hai ke saath enter kiya ja sakta hai, aur DLG provider Companies Act, 2013 ke under incorporated hona chahiye.
system_answer:
DLG provider ke roop mein wahi entity ban sakti hai jo:

*   Ek Lending Service Provider (LSP) ho ya koi anya RE (Regulated Entity) ho jiske saath RE ne outsourcing (LSP) arrangement kiya ho [RBI/2023-24/41::3-dup1].
*   LSP ke roop mein DLG provide karne wali entity ka Companies Act, 2013 ke tahat ek company ke roop mein incorporated hona anivarya hai [RBI/2025-26/36::18], [RBI/2023-24/41::3-dup1].

question: Digital lending me borrower ka data kahan store hona chahiye?
expected_answer: Saara data India me hi store hona chahiye. Agar kisi wajah se data India ke bahar process hota hai, to use 24 ghante ke andar delete karna ya India wapas laana zaroori hai.
system_answer: Pata nahi — is corpus me iska jawab available nahi hai.

question: DLA (Digital Lending App) apps borrower ke phone se kya-kya access nahi kar sakti?
expected_answer: DLAs borrower ki file/media storage, contact list, call logs, aur telephony functions access nahi kar sakti. Camera/microphone/location ka one-time access sirf onboarding/KYC ke liye, explicit consent ke saath, allowed hai.
system_answer:
JAWAB:

Regulated Entities (RE) ko yeh sunishchit karna hoga ki unke DLA (Digital Lending Apps) aur unke LSP (Lending Service Provider) ke DLA mobile phone ke nimnlikhit resources ko access na karein:

*   File and media [RBI/2025-26/36::12(i)], [RBI/2022-23/111::10.1]
*   Contact list [RBI/2025-26/36::12(i)], [RBI/2022-23/111::10.1]
*   Call logs [RBI/2025-26/36::12(i)], [RBI/2022-23/111::10.1]
*   Telephony functions [RBI/2025-26/36::12(i)], [RBI/2022-23/111::10.1]

Iske alawa, kisi bhi anya prakar ke mobile phone resources ko access karne se bhi DLAs ko rokna (desist) hoga [RBI/2025-26/36::12(i)], [RBI/2022-23/111::10.1].

question: Loan disbursal borrower ke account me directly hona zaroori hai ya LSP ke through bhi ho sakta hai?
expected_answer: Disbursal sirf borrower ke bank account me directly honi chahiye (statutory mandates, co-lending, ya specific end-use beneficiary cases ko chhodkar). Koi third-party ya LSP pass-through account allowed nahi hai.
system_answer:
JAWAB: Loan disbursal hamesha borrower ke bank account mein hi hona chahiye [RBI/2025-26/36::9(i)]. REs ko yeh sunishchit karna hoga ki kisi bhi sthiti mein disbursal third-party account mein na ho, jisme LSP aur unke DLA ke accounts bhi shamil hain [RBI/2025-26/36::9(i), RBI/2022-23/111::3].

Iske kuch apvaad (exceptions) hain:
1. Statutory ya regulatory mandate (RBI ya kisi anya regulator ka) [RBI/2025-26/36::9(i)].
2. Co-lending transactions ke dauran REs ke beech paise ka pravah [RBI/2025-26/36::9(i)].
3. Specific end-use ke liye disbursal, basharte loan seedhe end-beneficiary ke bank account mein jama kiya jaye [RBI/2025-26/36::9(i)].

question: Multi-lender LSP arrangement me offer display kab se mandatory hai aur usme kya dikhana zaroori hai?
expected_answer: 1 November 2025 se effective. Offer display me lender name(s), loan amount/tenor, APR, monthly repayment, penal charges, aur KFS ka link dikhana zaroori hai. Content unbiased aur objective hona chahiye, dark patterns allowed nahi.
system_answer:
Multi-lender LSP arrangement mein offer display ke sambandh mein niyam nimnlikhit hain:

*   **Mandatory requirement:** Jab ek LSP ke paas digital lending ke liye multiple REs ke saath agreements hote hain, tab LSP ko borrower ki request se match karne wale sabhi loan offers ka digital view DLA (Digital Lending App) par provide karna mandatory hai [RBI/2025-26/36::6(i)].
*   **Digital view mein kya dikhana zaroori hai:**
    *   Matching lenders ke loan offers ka digital view [RBI/2025-26/36::6(i)].
    *   Unmatched lenders ke naam ka disclosure [RBI/2025-26/36::6(i)].
    *   Loan offer dene wale RE(s) ka naam, loan ki rashi (amount) aur tenor, APR, monthly repayment obligation, aur penal charges (yadi lagu ho) [RBI/2025-26/36::6(iii)].
    *   Har RE ke liye KFS (Key Fact Statement) ka ek link [RBI/2025-26/36::6(iii)].

Yeh jankari is tarah se display honi chahiye taaki borrower alag-alag offers ke beech fair comparison kar sake [RBI/2025-26/36::6(iii)].

question: DLA reporting RBI ke CIMS portal pe kab tak complete karni thi?
expected_answer: 15 June 2025 tak saari DLA reporting CIMS portal pe complete karni thi.
system_answer: JAWAB: RE (Regulated Entity) ko sabhi DLA (Digital Lending Apps) ki reporting CIMS portal par 15 June, 2025 tak complete karni thi [RBI/2025-26/36::17(vii)].

question: Grievance redressal me complaint resolve na ho to borrower kahan escalate kar sakta hai?
expected_answer: 30 din ke andar resolve na hone ya reject hone par, borrower RBI-Integrated Ombudsman Scheme (RB-IOS) me escalate kar sakta hai, ya Chandigarh address pe physical complaint file kar sakta hai.
system_answer:
Agar borrower ki shikayat RE (Regulated Entity) ya LSP (Lending Service Provider) dwara puri tarah ya anshik roop se reject kar di jati hai, ya borrower jawab se santusht nahi hai, ya phir RE dwara shikayat prapt hone ke 30 dino ke bhitar koi jawab nahi milta hai, to borrower nimnalikhit jagah par shikayat escalate kar sakta hai:

1. **Complaint Management System (CMS) portal:** Reserve Bank-Integrated Ombudsman Scheme (RB-IOS) ke antargat [RBI/2025-26/36::11(iv)], [RBI/2022-23/111::6.2].
2. **Physical Complaint:** “Centralised Receipt and Processing Centre, 4th Floor, Reserve Bank of India, Sector-17, Central Vista, Chandigarh - 160017” par bheji ja sakti hai [RBI/2025-26/36::11(iv)].

Jin entities par RB-IOS lagu nahi hota, wahan RBI dwara nirdharit grievance redressal mechanism ke anusar shikayat darj ki ja sakti hai [RBI/2022-23/111::6.2].

question: Credit card EMI programs is Directions ke scope me aate hain kya?
expected_answer: Nahi. Credit card EMI programs 21 April 2022 ke Master Direction se governed hote hain, is 2025 Directions ke scope se bahar hain. Baaki card-based loans is Directions me cover hote hain.
system_answer: JAWAB: Nahi, Credit card EMI programmes in Directions ke scope mein nahi aate hain. Credit card EMI programmes vishesh roop se 'Master Direction on Credit Card and Debit Card – Issuance and Conduct, 2022' ke Para 6(b)(iii)12 dwara shasit (governed) hote hain aur ye transactions in Directions ke antargat cover nahi kiye jayenge [RBI/2025-26/36::29].

question: RE ko borrower ki creditworthiness assess karte waqt automatic credit limit increase allowed hai kya?
expected_answer: Nahi, borrower ki explicit aur recorded request ke bina automatic credit limit increase prohibited hai.
system_answer:
JAWAB: Nahi, RE ko automatic credit limit increase ki anumati nahi hai. 

RE ko yeh sunishchit karna hoga ki credit limit mein koi bhi automatic badhotri na ho, jab tak ki borrower se iske liye spasht anurodh (explicit request) prapt na ho, uska mulyankan na kiya gaya ho aur use record par na rakha gaya ho [RBI/2025-26/36::7]. Iske alawa, RE ko yeh bhi sunishchit karna hoga ki aisi har badhotri ke liye borrower ki spasht sahamati (explicit consent) record par li jaye [RBI/2022-23/111::7].

question: DLG arrangement ke through NBFC-P2P (peer-to-peer lending) enter kar sakti hai kya?
expected_answer: Nahi, NBFC-P2P DLG arrangement me existing P2P Master Direction ke tehat enter nahi kar sakti.
system_answer: JAWAB: Nahi, NBFC-P2P DLG arrangements me enter nahi kar sakti. RBI ke nirdeshon ke anusar, NBFC-P2P apne platform par facilitate kiye gaye loans ke liye DLG arrangements me enter nahi kar sakti hai [RBI/2025-26/36::20(iii)].

question: DLG kis form me accept kiya ja sakta hai?
expected_answer: Teen forms accepted hain: cash RE ke paas rakha hua, fixed deposit (scheduled bank me, RE ke favour me lien ke saath), ya bank guarantee RE ke favour me.

question: 2025 Directions ne kaunse teen purane circulars ko repeal kiya?
expected_answer: 24 June 2020 ka circular (digital lending fair practices), 2 September 2022 ke Guidelines on Digital Lending, aur 8 June 2023 ke DLG Guidelines — teeno repeal ho gaye. In repealed circulars ke tehat pehle liye gaye actions/penalties valid rahenge agar naye Directions se consistent hain.
system_answer:
Pata nahi — is corpus me iska jawab available nahi hai. 

CONTEXT mein Annex III ka zikr hai aur ye bataya gaya hai ki Annex III mein mention kiye gaye circulars repeal ho gaye hain [RBI/2025-26/36::30], lekin us Annex III ki list mein specific circulars ke naam ya sankhya (teen circulars) ka vivaran is text mein nahi diya gaya hai.

question: 2025 Directions me aisa kya naya hai jo 2022 ki Guidelines on Digital Lending me nahi tha?
expected_answer: 2025 Directions me naye additions hain: Para 6 (multi-lender LSP arrangements me offer matching/transparency), Para 17 (CIMS portal pe DLA directory reporting), Para 10 (cooling-off period), aur Paras 12-14 me comprehensive data/privacy provisions. Ye 2022 Guidelines me is form me nahi the — 2025 Directions inhe naya add karti hain, purani teeno circulars ko consolidate karte hue.
source_document: RBI (Digital Lending) Directions, 2025 (Para 1 preamble + Para 30 repeal provisions)
system_answer: Pata nahi — is corpus me iska jawab available nahi hai. Diye gaye CONTEXT mein 2025 Directions aur 2022 Guidelines ke beech ke antar (differences) ka vivaran nahi diya gaya hai.

question: DLG guidelines (2023) aur 2025 Directions ke DLG chapter me kya continuity hai?
expected_answer: 2025 Directions ka Chapter VI, 2023 ki DLG Guidelines ko comprehensively restate karta hai — 5% cap clarify hui (illustrations ke saath), aur 120-day invocation timeline retain hui hai. Detailed clause-by-clause fark verify karne ke liye 2023 ki guidelines ka original text chahiye — wo abhi humare corpus me exact citation ke saath available nahi hai, sirf 2025 Directions ka apna summary hai.
system_answer:
DLG guidelines (2023) aur 2025 Directions ke beech continuity ke sambandh mein nimnlikhit bindu diye gaye hain:

*   **Grievance Redressal:** DLG arrangements se sambandhit customer protection aur grievance redressal ke mamle ab bhi 'Guidelines on Digital Lending' (dated September 02, 2022) aur anya lagu niyam-kanoonon dwara nirdharit honge [RBI/2023-24/41::13].
*   **Repeal aur Actions ki Validity:** In Directions ke jari hone par purane circulars (jo Annex-III mein ullekhit hain) repeal (radd) ho gaye hain [RBI/2025-26/36::30(i)]. Halanki, repeal hone ke bawajood, purane niyam-kanoonon ke tahat ki gayi koi bhi karwai, diye gaye nirdesh, ya lagaya gaya jurmana, jo in nayi Directions ke pravdhanon ke sath asangat (inconsistent) nahi hai, use in nayi Directions ke tahat hi kiya gaya mana jayega [RBI/2025-26/36::30(ii)].
*   **Definitions:** In guidelines mein upyog kiye gaye aur jo shabd paribhashit nahi hain, unka wahi arth hoga jo 'Guidelines on Digital Lending' (dated September 02, 2022) mein diya gaya hai [RBI/2023-24/41::2-dup1].

question: LSP ko RE ke bina consent ke fees kaun deta hai — RE ya borrower?
expected_answer: LSP ki fees RE directly deti hai. Borrower se ye fee charge nahi ki ja sakti.
system_answer: JAWAB: LSP ko fees, charges, ya reimbursements ka bhugtan seedhe RE dwara kiya jata hai. RE ko yeh sunishchit karna hota hai ki ye shulk borrower se alag se na liye jayein aur na hi LSP dwara borrower se vasule jayein [RBI/2025-26/36::9] [RBI/2022-23/111::4-dup1].

question: Cash recovery ke case me (delinquent loans), kya recovery amount RE ke account me directly jaana zaroori hai?
expected_answer: Cash recovery ko direct-account requirement se exempt kiya gaya hai, par usi din RE ke account me reflect hona chahiye. LSP ki recovery fee RE khud deti hai, proceeds se deduct nahi hoti.
system_answer:
JAWAB: Nahi, delinquent loans ke mamle mein cash recovery ke liye RE ko operational flexibility di gayi hai, jiske tahat in transactions ko RE ke bank account mein seedhe repayment ki requirement se chhoot (exemption) di gayi hai [RBI/2025-26/36::9(v)]. 

Halanki, RE ko yeh sunishchit karna hoga ki:
1. Cash mein ki gayi koi bhi recovery usi din borrower ke account mein poori tarah reflect ho [RBI/2025-26/36::9(v)].
2. Aisi recovery ke liye LSP ko diye jaane wale fees ya charges ka bhugtan RE dwara seedhe kiya jaye, aur ise LSP dwara borrower se direct ya indirect roop se vasoola na jaye [RBI/2025-26/36::9(v)].

question: DLG disclosure requirements ke tehat LSP ko kitni baar aur kya publish karna hota hai?
expected_answer: LSP ko monthly, month-end ke 7 working days ke andar, total portfolio number aur respective amounts publish karne hote hain jahan DLG offer ki gayi hai. RE ka naam disclose karna optional hai.
system_answer:
DLG disclosure requirements ke tehat LSP ko nimnlikhit jaankari publish karni hoti hai:

*   **Kya publish karna hai:** LSP ko apni website par un sabhi portfolios ki kul sankhya (total number of portfolios) aur har portfolio ki raashi (respective amount) publish karni hogi jin par DLG offer kiya gaya hai [RBI/2025-26/36::27(i)]. Is disclosure mein RE ka naam disclose karna anivarya nahi hai [RBI/2025-26/36::27(i)].
*   **Kitni baar publish karna hai:** Yeh disclosure monthly basis par ki jani chahiye [RBI/2025-26/36::27(ii)].
*   **Timeline:** Kisi bhi mahine ki disclosure us mahine ke khatam hone ke baad agle 7 working days ke bheetar ho jani chahiye [RBI/2025-26/36::27(ii)].
